sources.title: RLVE OPD teacher: DiscreteLogarithm - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B trained for 150 steps on difficulty-0 DiscreteLogarithm prompts, with four prompts and 16 rollouts per step. Training did not use DAPO prompt filtering. These are the final model weights at step 149 for environment-specific on-policy distillation.

sources.title: David Heineman
sources.snippet: I've developed new and efficient tools for measuring model behavior [4, 5], and built receipes for fully-open language models [6, 7]. Recently, I've been thinking about how methods from pretraining can help us build vision-language, speech-language and reasoning models.
